matrix_name.name: Polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Foam prepared from trifunctional polyether polyol, dibutyltin dilaurate, organosilicon stabilizer, deionized water, and toluene diisocyanate (TDI).

fillers.name: Iron(II,III) oxide@Polyvinyl alcohol
fillers.description: Dispersive magnetic spheres of Fe3O4@PVA. Fe3O4 nanoparticles coated with Polyvinyl alcohol.

fillers.name: Graphene oxide@silver
fillers.description: Silver nanoparticles loaded on Graphene oxide (GO). GO was first treated with KH-550 to get amino-rich GO.
